client_authority: Current verified USER JWT and current locked active owner/admin workspace membership; no caller actor/workspace/role input.

gates.database: private settings.enabled=true; defaultfalse and not bypassed by direct RPC

input.query: 2..100 Unicode codepoints; only generated title/reference/category and safe authorized relation labels
input.target: optional closed kind/id for existing6 target kinds
input.format: pdf|image; current byte contracts PDF/PNG/JPEG only
input.created_from: optional inclusive canonical ISO-millisecond UTC instant
input.created_before: optional exclusive canonical ISO-millisecond UTC instant
input.cursor: optional opaque bounded base64url; never URL/query log

output: Closed DocumentLibraryPageV2 / DocumentLibraryEntryV2. No raw filename/path/object reference/private note/content capability. Exact total is evaluated with the page in one authorized statement. Partial cannot advertise exact totals.
consistency: live_reauthorized_creation_cutoff, not a repeatable snapshot. Current status/labels/relationships can change counts between calls; each row is freshly authorized.
cursor: Encrypted+integrity protected, ten-minute maximum; binds actor/workspace/current membership+workspace revisions including xmin/filter hash/sort/limit. Manipulated/expired/foreign/stale cursors are validation failures. Rotation invalidates old cursors.
minimization: See docs/master/documents-pro-v2/D1_MINIMIZATION_POLICY.json. Owner requests minimized title/date/context; original file_name remains protected and unsearchable.
legacy: document.v1 and document.content.v1 remain unchanged. Optional repository capability has no fallback global inventory.
